fields.title: Restore the Notion mapping and sync the podcast addition
fields.description: Virtuoso 1.15 refuses a mapping with both lane and workstream. Map workstream to the populated Lane column and drop the lane alias, keeping every Lane value and the Workstream column; then sync the owner's podcast direction into PODCAST-SOURCE-1's Description and Notes with an SQL read-back.
fields.notes: Created 2026-10-15 by Blurby.Roadmap at the owner's request, from held plan 2026-10-15-notion-mapping-podcast-sync (HB-4), whose full specification it points to. Runs before ELECTRON-42-UPGRADE-1 resumes.
